name: Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc
source: CRON 20261014: Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc condensed statement of profit or loss and other comprehensive income for the half year ended 30 June 2026 (NGX doclib filing library), 6 months ended 30 June 2026 column, N'000 scaled to naira. Revenue less Direct cost equals the printed Gross profit, Profit from operation less net finance cost equals the printed operating profit before taxation, and Tax expense reproduces the printed Profit for the year. The same rows reproduce the audited 31 December 2025 column already stored. | NGX (doclib.ngxgroup.com) | CRON 2026-10-06: 4 blank cell(s) filled from https://stockanalysis.com/quote/ngx/SKYAVN/financials/income-statement/ . Every value this file already stored agreed with that page within 0.5%, so the fill is additive. Revenue minus Cost of Sales equals Gross Profit and Profit Before Tax minus Income Tax equals Net Profit were re-checked per period; Net Profit was withheld where the source's own figures do not tie. | FILL 20261007_145458: Proshare NGX results note (FY2023 revenue 16.55bn, profit before tax 2.63bn, profit after tax 1.95bn) and independent.ng report (FY2022 profit before tax 469m, profit after tax 309m) | CRON 20261117: 9M 2026 column from the Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc condensed statement of profit or loss for the nine months ended 30 September 2026, NGX doclib, nine months ended 30 September 2026 column, printed in N thousand and stored as absolute naira. Revenue 34,259,808; direct cost 16,365,143; gross profit 17,894,664; other operating income 515,955; administration expenses 10,092,679; profit from operation 8,317,939; net finance cost 236,146 is finance expense 500,726 less finance income 264,580; profit before taxation 8,081,793; tax expense 2,747,810; profit for the year 5,333,984. Ties exactly on both identities. The page prints no earnings per share. | CRON 20261121: 9M 2026 EPS filled from Skyway Aviation Handling Company Plc Q3 2026 unaudited condensed statement of profit or loss, nine months ended 30 September 2026 column, basic earnings per share printed as 394 kobo and stored as 3.94 naira. Cross-check: 9M 2026 profit of 5,333,984 thousand divided by the 1,353 million shares implied by the FY2025 EPS (9,741,630 thousand over 7.196937 naira) gives 3.94 naira, so the printed figure and the stored net profit agree.
